limitations: Only closed ordinary scalar-field structures, borrowed direct calls and real decrement/release are admitted. Recursion, arrays, strings, closures, general inductives and static lifted objects reject.

Durable exact/1 identity binds the mathematical semantic checker/environment, original goal and revision. It does not store the compiled arithmetic ELF or runtime digest per attempt. Execution artifacts are independently source-bound here.
All boot paths in these bundles remain ELF-preload development boot.
Earlier source/elaboration/object failures remain retained under ignored build paths; their results are not replaced.
